### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Implement fused row-wise softmax in Triton with stable max subtraction, register reductions, and masked column tails.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def triton_fused_softmax(x: list) -> list:
    arr = np.array(x, dtype=float)
    m = np.max(arr, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    exp_x = np.exp(arr - m)
    return np.round(exp_x / np.sum(exp_x, axis=-1, keepdims=True), 6).tolist()
```
